spanish: Y la grasa del pecado hará humear hacia el altar.

findings.issue: את marks חֵלֶב as the object of 3ms hiphil יַקְטִיר. Spanish makes la grasa the subject of hará humear and drops the masculine singular agent.
findings.spanishSpan: la grasa del pecado hará humear

notes: hacia el altar matches the directional suffix on the altar token.
